verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API endpoints for linking receipts and invoices to existing transactions and for downloading receipts. These are developer building blocks for attaching receipts, not a documented feature that matches receipts automatically. There is no evidence of e-receipts pulled from integrations or of targeted missing-receipt reminders.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing
